title: SIMPLE IRA, Explained Simply
custom_excerpt: A low-cost small-business retirement plan with a built-in employer match.
meta_title: SIMPLE IRA Explained Simply | Thrifty Crew
meta_description: What a SIMPLE IRA is, how the employer match works, contribution limits, and a real-dollar example of the free money you could be earning.
lexical: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A SIMPLE IRA is a low-cost retirement plan for small businesses that lets both the owner and the employees contribute, with the company chipping in too.","type":"extended-text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"SIMPLE stands for Savings Incentive Match Plan for Employees. It is built for businesses with 100 or fewer workers that want to offer a retirement plan without the cost and headache of a full 401(k). You set it up once, and everyone can contribute straight from their paychecks.","type":"extended-text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What makes it stand out is the employer match. The business must either match employee contributions up to 3 percent of pay, or put in a flat 2 percent for everyone whether they contribute or not. That is real money landing in your account on top of what you save yourself. For 2026, employees can defer up to 17,000 dollars, with an extra 4,000 dollars if you are 50 or older.","type":"extended-text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Picture a small landscaping company. An employee earning 45,000 dollars decides to put in 5 percent, which is 2,250 dollars for the year. The owner matches 3 percent of pay, adding another 1,350 dollars. So this worker banks 3,600 dollars toward retirement, and 1,350 of it was free. Do that for a decade and the match alone is worth a small fortune.","type":"extended-text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Bottom line:","type":"extended-text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" A SIMPLE IRA gives a small business an easy, affordable way to help its people save, and that employer match is close to free money you should not leave on the table.","type":"extended-text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This is general education, not personal financial advice.
